title: Making Self-Driving Laboratories Auditable:A Unified Framework for Hybrid Actions,Measurements, and Safe Execution
abstract: arXiv:2610.36761v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) are laboratory systems that couple experimental planning, automated execution, and measurement feedback in a closed loop. Integrating flexible robot control with the typed application programming interfaces (APIs) and continuous measurements exposed by laboratory instruments remains an execution-interface challenge. To address this challenge, we propose a traceable framework comprising four components: LAM (Lab Action Model), OpenSDL, Safe-SDL, and L3-Bench. LAM is a proposed measurement-conditioned policy architecture that extends vision-language-action paradigms to generate both continuous robot trajectories and typed instrument API calls. OpenSDL is an execution substrate with an initial control implementation, designed to map role-level operations to heterogeneous devices, coordinate execution, and record timestamped causal events. translated_title: 让自动驾驶实验室可审计：面向混合动作、测量与安全执行的统一框架
translated_abstract: 自动驾驶实验室（SDL）是将实验规划、自动化执行与测量反馈以闭环方式耦合在一起的实验室系统。如何将灵活的机器人控制与实验室仪器所暴露的类型化应用程序接口（API）和连续测量整合起来，仍然是一个执行接口层面的挑战。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一个可追溯的框架，包含四个组件：LAM（实验室动作模型）、OpenSDL、Safe-SDL 和 L3-Bench。LAM 是一种所提出的以测量为条件的策略架构，它扩展了视觉-语言-动作范式，能够同时生成连续的机器人轨迹和类型化的仪器 API 调用。OpenSDL 是一个具备初始控制实现的执行底座，旨在将角色级操作映射到异构设备、协调执行并记录带时间戳的因果事件。所提出的 Safe-SDL 运行时门控结合了调度前的模式……
tldr: 该论文提出了由LAM、OpenSDL、Safe-SDL和L3-Bench四个组件构成的可追溯统一框架，使自动驾驶实验室能够统一生成混合的机器人动作与仪器API调用、协调异构设备安全执行，并实现全程可审计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified traceable framework—comprising LAM, OpenSDL, Safe-SDL, and L3-Bench—that enables self-driving laboratories to generate hybrid robot actions and typed instrument API calls, coordinate heterogeneous devices safely, and remain fully auditable.
